steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation flow specified by the case.
Set the event type to RFQ.
Provide the required title and a value to search for after publishing.
Apply the RFQ template so the pricing sheet is available.
Add one line item using the closest available product search.
Populate the remaining pricing-sheet fields with valid defaults.
Set the requested quantity from the case.
Attempt to set the requested delivery location using the sheet cell.
Invite one available QA vendor so publishing can proceed.
Commit the 30-minute schedule specified by the case.
Perform the second publish click as the closest available representation of the requested double-click.
Verify that the event was created and the browser reached its project page.
Return to the events list to check for duplicate creation.
Search for the event created by this plan.
Assert that exactly one matching event row exists.
